title: Decide the Google OAuth secrets: stay in Secrets Manager
description: Part of story chatticus-a170754a (Secrets and generated keys live in SSM Parameter Store SecureString, created by infrastructure code); read its description for the full plan, order and hazards. chatticus/{development,staging,production}/oauth/google are created by hand and imported by name in infra/lib/auth-stack.ts (Secret.fromSecretNameV2). AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider ProviderDetails is not in the ssm-secure supported list, so they stay in Secrets Manager (1.20 USD per month). The value is vendor-issued by Google so a one-time manual put is inherent. Options for the owner: (a) keep as is, (b) CDK owns an empty Secret shell with tags and the owner puts the value once, (c) custom resource reading an SSM SecureString and calling Cognito (more code, not recommended). Owner decision needed.
